style: Single 3D app icon of {subject}, made of clear frosted borosilicate glass with precise bevelled edges and subtle refraction. {accent} Isometric three-quarter view, centered, occupying about 60% of the frame. Perfectly flat solid matte background of exact color #0D0E11, no vignette, no gradient, no floor, no reflection surface, no text, no letters, no numbers, no emoji. Soft studio key light from top left, crisp specular highlights on glass edges, photorealistic product render, sharp focus.
motion: Locked-off static camera, no camera movement. {motion} A soft band of light sweeps once across the glass surfaces. Background stays perfectly solid flat #0D0E11 with no changes. Calm, precise, minimal motion, seamless loop that ends exactly as it starts.

icons.subject: three stacked thin rectangular plates (a layered project stack)
icons.accent: The middle plate has a thin glowing signal-red (#E5322D) edge line and a tiny engraved millimetre ruler tick pattern along one side, like a precision engineering instrument.
icons.motion: The three plates slowly drift apart vertically by a small amount and then settle back into the exact original stacked position. The thin red edge line gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: a thick rounded rectangular identity card standing slightly tilted, with a circular lens window in its upper half
icons.accent: The lens has a thin signal-red (#E5322D) ring and fine engraved crosshair lines, and a row of tiny engraved measurement ticks runs along the bottom edge of the card.
icons.motion: The card rotates very slightly left and back to its exact original angle. The red lens ring gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: a graduation mortarboard cap with a flat square top
icons.accent: A thin signal-red (#E5322D) tassel cord hangs from the center button, and the square top has a fine engraved grid pattern like drafting paper.
icons.motion: The cap hovers up slightly and returns to its exact position. The red tassel sways gently and comes to rest.

icons.subject: a compact rectangular briefcase with a short handle
icons.accent: A thin signal-red (#E5322D) seam line runs horizontally around the case, and the side panel has tiny engraved millimetre ruler ticks.
icons.motion: The briefcase lifts slightly and settles back to its exact position. The red seam line gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: a square microchip processor with short pins on all four sides
icons.accent: Fine engraved circuit traces run across its surface toward a small square core that glows signal-red (#E5322D).
icons.motion: Tiny points of red light travel along the engraved circuit traces toward the core, and the red core gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: three small glass cubes arranged in a diagonal row and connected by thin straight rods
icons.accent: The connecting rods are thin glowing signal-red (#E5322D) lines, and each cube has a tiny engraved corner tick mark.
icons.motion: A small pulse of red light travels from the first cube through the rods to the last cube, then the light fades back to the starting state.

icons.subject: a round medal seal disc with two short ribbon tails below it
icons.accent: The disc rim has fine engraved radial tick marks like a precision dial, and a thin signal-red (#E5322D) ring runs inside the rim.
icons.motion: The medal turns slightly on its vertical axis and returns to its exact original angle. The red ring gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: a closed rectangular envelope
icons.accent: The flap edge is outlined with a thin glowing signal-red (#E5322D) line and a small round seal sits where the flap meets the body.
icons.motion: The envelope floats up slightly and settles back to its exact position. The red flap line gently pulses brighter and back.

icons.subject: a single thick document sheet with a folded top-right corner, standing upright and slightly tilted
icons.accent: Fine engraved horizontal text-like lines fill the sheet, and a thin signal-red (#E5322D) downward arrow is engraved near the bottom.
icons.motion: The red downward arrow gently glows brighter and moves a tiny distance down then back up. The sheet stays still.

icons.subject: a rounded rectangular speech bubble with a short tail
icons.accent: Three small engraved dots sit in its center and a small solid signal-red (#E5322D) notification dot sits on its top-right corner.
icons.motion: The red notification dot gently pulses brighter and back, and the speech bubble bobs very slightly and returns to its exact position.

icons.subject: a round analog gauge dial in a thick bezel
icons.accent: The dial face itself is also translucent frosted glass (not white, not opaque) with fine engraved tick marks around its edge, and a thin signal-red (#E5322D) needle.
icons.motion: The red needle sweeps smoothly from its position up toward the high end and back to its exact starting position.
